transcript: Your body has been waiting to hear this. Stay with me. Wherever you are right now, just look around and find the nearest door. Notice it, remember it, and then come back here with me. Now, you can close your eyes if you want, or just stay present. But I want you to imagine something simple through that door. Someone you deeply care for walks in. Someone who has loved you in a real, gentle way. A friend, a family member, a person from your past, or even someone you wish existed. Imagine they walk slowly toward you. They sit down right in front of you. They take your hands. They look into your eyes, and they say, You are good. There is nothing wrong with you. Nothing that needs to be fixed, and you're going to be okay. Just breathe for a moment, and notice what that feels like inside your body. Let that feeling settle, even if it's only for a few seconds. Now gently place your hand on your own heart. You don't have to feel anything special, just touch, and I want you to take the same warmth that this person gave you, and give it back to yourself. Say quietly, I am good. There is nothing wrong with me. Nothing that needs to be fixed, and I'm going to be okay. Hold that feeling. Return to it whenever life feels heavy.
